verdict.rationale: SerpApi is itself a documented public API, with per-engine parameter references (location, output format including LLM-oriented markdown, field filtering, async submission with Searches Archive retrieval). Official client libraries with code samples, machine-readable llms.txt and .md docs pages, and community users driving it via API back this up. One HN commenter criticizes putting the API key in the URL, which is a design gripe rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths 404).
